typePromptPrefixes.item: Item icon rule: isolated active item sprite on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF, hot pink, magenta, or purple anywhere in the item. Keep the entire object fully inside the canvas with generous transparent-safe padding. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no table, no grid lines, no checkerboard.
